_comment: Input to L1-inception-task-generator, BOM Phase 3. The BOM row names stories.json as the only input, but the v2.1 scope note places behaviour-level test design BETWEEN story-generator and task-generator — scenario-writer -> adversarial-case-writer -> case-writer mint the case_ids that this agent binds as verification_ref, and gr-L1-verification-ref-resolvable blocks any Work Unit whose verifier does not exist. Test cases are therefore a required input, not an optional one: T3 cannot be satisfied without them.
_bom_note: Appendix B.2 offers 'OIDC token validation & role provisioning' as an example of a T1-compliant title, while T1's encoded check forbids a coordinating conjunction ('and'/'&'/','-joined verbs) in the title. The two cannot both hold. This example follows the encoded check, because that is what the guardrail actually runs, and the T1 block below shows the consequence.

acceptance_criteria.summary: well-formed FBO number accepted, held pending-verification
malformed FBO number refused, no record created
missing attestation refused server-side, not client-bypassable

stories.title: Asynchronous FBO verification and its outcomes

acceptance_criteria.summary: valid lookup -> registration valid, evidence recorded, publication permitted
invalid lookup -> rejected, producer notified, publication blocked
lookup timeout -> stays pending and retries, never optimistically valid
duplicate verification delivery -> no second evidence record
external party authenticates via external IdP, no employee-directory credential
role provisioned from onboarding record, no default elevated role
invalid token refused server-side, not client-bypassable

content.execution_summary: • 2 story slices under F1.1; F5.1 carried unsliced. 15 acceptance criteria.

cases.title: External party authenticates through the external IdP
Role provisioned from the onboarding record, never defaulted
Replayed token with altered role claim is refused
Well-formed FBO number accepted and held pending
Malformed FBO number refused, no record created
Attestation flag forged client-side is ignored by the server
Producer entity persists a pending-verification registration
Valid FBO lookup marks the registration valid against a stubbed register
Invalid lookup rejects the registration and notifies the producer
Lookup timeout leaves the registration pending and schedules a retry
Duplicate verification delivery creates no second evidence record

content.execution_summary: • 14 cases minted: 11 behaviour, 3 adversarial. These are the only ids a verification_ref may resolve to.

decomposition_standard.threshold_note: N=12 and 0.5 x window are the defaults; both are overridable per L2/L3 domain variant via knowledge_bases_append. This run used the defaults.

cycle_context.capacity_note: Supplied for the capacity signal only. Fitting Work Units to a cycle and assigning disposition is L1-planning-feature-cycle-planner's decision, not this agent's.
